objective: Preallocate IN-subquery materialized expression lists from result row counts.

tasks.title: Preallocate IN-subquery lists
tasks.result: IN-subquery materialization now preallocates the SQL expression list from the known result row count before taking each row's first value.

notes: Cargo/linker verification used an E: workspace temp directory because the default C:/TEMP drive was full.
The materialization still skips empty rows and converts only each result row's first value.
